claims.initialMaskAreaTendsToZero: Butt subarc area tends to zero with arc length; both growing cap disc areas tend to zero because radius=min(7,d). Fixed original-P intersection cannot increase reveal area.

proofMethod.initialQ: Each exact MQ uses independent Fraction u/v/lambda/chord/curvature tests at T1/2 K1/20; no foreign-source approval reused.
proofMethod.sourceP: Exact ear triangulation and polygon-touch graph. Each adaptive leaf triangle has an exact rational Q(t) witness with all vertices strictly inside radius7; convex disc covers the whole triangle.
proofMethod.limits: Final tube inclusion and connected P do not prove every intermediate P/reveal intersection or prior-stroke attachment.
